source.spawnSource: measured draw-covered path first point + the slice spawn heading (first 2 m tangent); not a retail start line

course.rule: point-to-point measured path; the spawn is the first layout point and the finish is the last
course.name: usa_la_longbeachdocks measured draw-covered path

span.note: arcs are measured by summing the float32 layout buffer in this builder (818.371718 m); the declared 818.371716 m path agrees within 2e-6 m

band.source: declared controller and respawn band for this measured path; usa_la_longbeachdocks has no measured car-width band

coverage.note: draw coverage, not car-width gate coverage; see docs/work/analysis/map-slice-longbeach.md

coverage.source: map-slice layout verification (measured path points, not a car-width band test)
coverage.note: the gate line is derived from the measured polyline; gate-width draw/collision coverage was not measured for usa_la_longbeachdocks

coverage.source: map-slice layout verification (measured path points, not a car-width band test)
coverage.note: the gate line is derived from the measured polyline; gate-width draw/collision coverage was not measured for usa_la_longbeachdocks

coverage.source: map-slice layout verification (measured path points, not a car-width band test)
coverage.note: the gate line is derived from the measured polyline; gate-width draw/collision coverage was not measured for usa_la_longbeachdocks

coverage.source: map-slice layout verification (measured path points, not a car-width band test)
coverage.note: the gate line is derived from the measured polyline; gate-width draw/collision coverage was not measured for usa_la_longbeachdocks

countdown.rule: input is held at zero until the countdown reaches GO; the timer starts at GO and the car is on the start line

rules.timer: elapsed engine ticks from GO at 1/60 s; keeps running across a respawn and freezes on the finish
rules.gateOrder: checkpoints count only in index order; a finish crossing is rejected until every checkpoint is passed
rules.progress: progress is the arc length of the nearest point on the measured usa_la_longbeachdocks path, clamped to the finish arc

respawn.target: the gate point of the last passed checkpoint (the start line before the first checkpoint)
respawn.rule: respawn when the chassis falls more than 1 m below the measured ground at its arc, stays airborne for 30 ticks, or leaves the declared band; the attempt timer keeps running and the last checkpoint is kept

limits: one point-to-point sprint on the measured usa_la_longbeachdocks draw-covered path, not a lap and not a retail start line
the 6 m band is a declared controller/respawn band, not a measured road width
gates are rules geometry only; no gate mesh is added to the render packet
the draw-covered path is 47.29 % of the collision diameter (818.372 m / 1,730.511 m); the rest of the collision surface has no direct-draw geometry in this package
no Longbeach prop colliders, opponents, AI or race audio
